Big Fight Weekend brings you our prediction, the full fight card, and streaming information ahead of Christian Mbilli vs Canelo Alvarez at the Kingdom Arena in Riyadh. The full card will be promoted by Ring Magazine , live on DAZN PPV and DAZN Ultimate. The main event will be for Mbilli's WBC super middleweight title.
 Christian Mbilli vs Canelo Alvarez fight details
 Date : Saturday, October 31, 2026.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Venue : Kingdom Arena, Riyadh.
 Start time : 09:15 ET / 13:15 GMT.
 Undercard fight to watch : David Picasso vs. Carl Martin.
 Current main event odds : Canelo -260, Mbilli +200.
 Christian Mbilli recent form
 Mbilli (29-0-1, 24 KOs) last fought on the undercard of Canelo Alvarez vs Terrence Crawford , where he was involved in a brilliant back-and-forth clash with Lester Martinez, with the bout ending in a split draw. Before that, the Cameroonian-born fighter had a perfect record, with his best wins coming against Sergiy Derevyanchenko, Maciej Sulecki, and Rohan Murdock.
 Canelo Alvarez recent form
 Saul "Canelo" Alvarez (63-3-2, 39 KOs) was last in action on September 13, 2025, losing his undisputed super middleweight crown to Terence "Bud" Crawford. He lost his titles by unanimous decision, with scorecards of 116-112 and 115-113 x2. Prior to that, Canelo had won six consecutive bouts since losing to Dmitry Bivol.
 Photo by Chris Unger/TKO Worldwide LLC via Getty Images
 The Big Fight Weekend verdict: Christian Mbilli vs Canelo Alvarez
 It remains to be seen whether this card actually goes ahead. It's staggering that it's still scheduled, considering the recent attacks in Riyadh and the numerous events over the next few weeks and months that have been subsequently cancelled . Dan Rafael is reporting that the Lindolfo Delgado vs Arthur Biyarslanov will " probably not " happen.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Looking at the main event, should it happen, it's an intriguing match-up. The main question for many, is how much Canelo Alvarez has left, which will be answered on October 31. In his prime, elite head movement, sharp counterpunching and excellent body punching were what made him a great fighter.
 Mbilli is an entertaining come-forward, throw-at-high-volume fighter, and will look to pressure Canelo and not let him settle. If the Mexican has enough of his old head movement left, he will make Mbilli miss and punish the Cameroonian-born fighter. We are backing Canelo to have enough of his old magic left and win by decision.
 Christian Mbilli vs Canelo Alvarez full fight card
 Christian Mbilli vs Canelo Alvarez, 12 rounds, for Mbilli's WBC super middleweight title
 Jaime Munguia vs Nikita Zon, 12 rounds, for Munguia's WBA super middleweight title
 Rafael Espinoza vs Ricardo Blandon, 12 rounds, for Espinoza's WBO featherweight title
 Lindolfo Delgado vs Arthur Biyarslanov, 12 rounds, for vacant IBF super lightweight title
 David Picasso vs Carl Martin, 12 rounds, super bantamweights
 Reito Tsutsumi vs Raymundo Rojas, 10 rounds, super featherweights
 Sultan Almohammed vs Erick Jahir Villegas, 6 rounds, super featherweights
 Bek Nurmaganbet vs Marcos Vazquez, 10 rounds, middleweights
 Carlos Emiliano Rojo Vazquez vs Flavius Biea, 8 rounds, middleweights
 Hector Aguirre vs Brayan Leon Salgado, 8 rounds, super middleweights
